candidates_inspected.title: Daily Shopify Product & Site Updates -- 2
candidates_inspected.description_excerpt:
I need a reliable hand to keep my Shopify store fresh every single day. I’ll send over complete product data—names, prices, stock numbers, full descriptions, photos, and category details—and you’ll jump straight into the Shopify admin to make the changes.

The routine:
• Add or edit new products as soon as I provide the details  
• Adjust prices and stock levels so inventory stays accurate  
• Swap out homepage banners, promotional graphics, or copy whenever a new campaign goes live  

Because everything runs on Shopify, familiarity with its bulk editor, CSV import, and image-handling tools will make this job smooth and fast. Accuracy matters more than speed, but I do need same-day turnaround on each batch I send.

Each update is considered done when the products display correctly, variants show the right stock quantities, pricing matches my file, and any promotional assets appear proper
candidates_inspected.assessment: Daily Shopify admin edits; requires authenticated Shopify admin access and ongoing daily availability (excluded: authenticated access)
